newsitem.title: UK: MarCH Forties crude to load 28.45 mln bbls. [CORRECTED 8:49 GMT]
newsitem.headline: MarCH Forties crude to load 28.45 mln bbls. [CORRECTED 8:49 GMT]

text.p: UK North Sea Forties will load 28.45 million barrels in March, including 1.55 million barrels direct to system operator BP's Grangemouth refinery, traders said on Wednesday.
(Amends figure in headline and text from 26.9 million bbls to include barrels delivered to Grangemouth).
Forties loaded 26.4 million barrels in February, including 1.4 million barrels to Grangemouth, they said.

The March programme, released to equity producers early on Wednesday, includes 24 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, 19 of 500,000 barrels, two of 550,000 barrels and one each of one million barrels and 900,000 barrels in addition to the Grangemouth volumes.
The February programme was made up of one one-million barrel, one 900,000-barrel cargo, 21 cargoes of 600,000 barrels and 21 cargoes of 500,000 barrels plus 1.4 million barrels direct to Grangemouth.
While the total volume is scheduled to be higher in March, in barrel per day terms it is lower because March is a longer month, traders said.
